name: SAVA A4
why_interesting: An entry-level full-carbon endurance road bike with a Shimano Tiagra 2×10 drivetrain and hydraulic discs at a claimed 9.5 kg.
missing: Current mainland price, stock, warranty and return route

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Tiagra R4700 2×10; Prowheel 50/34 and 11–34 cassette
facts.brakes: Sensah hydraulic shifters and hydraulic disc brakes
facts.frame: T800-claimed carbon frame, fork and seatpost
facts.stiffness_evidence: An independent exact-model Bilibili ride review reports good perceived frame rigidity and direct acceleration with race-oriented geometry. This is qualitative rider evidence, not a measured deflection result or reproducible stiffness protocol.

support_note: SAVA publishes a mainland shopping and after-sales route, but exact A4 stock, price and warranty conditions remain unresolved.
source_note: The exact global model RO8 CR-A4-R4700-20S is verified. Its claimed weight varies by size; the mainland brand route is known, but exact price and availability remain open.
